description: PAID, per call: search the Government of Canada's published CanadaBuys tender notices by keyword, procurement category, region and closing date range (give at least one). Returns up to 10 matches, each with reference and solicitation number, English and French title, publication and closing dates, status, category, notice type, procurement method, regions, the buying organization, goods and services descriptions and the notice address, plus the total matched, the data date and the attribution. Contact names, emails and phone numbers in the notices are not returned. This is not the official notice, and a notice can change or close after the data date. You are not charged when nothing matches.

category.description: The procurement category as the notice publishes it.

closing_from.description: Closing date on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

closing_to.description: Closing date on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

keyword.description: Words to find in the notice title, buyer and goods or services description. Every word must appear.

region.description: A region name as CanadaBuys publishes it, for example Ontario or National Capital Region. Matches regions of opportunity and of delivery.

name: search_canadabuys_tenders
